question_text: Under Article XIII of the 1987 Constitution, the State is mandated to protect the rights of workers and promote agrarian reform. Which of the following scenarios best illustrates the State's compliance with this mandate?

options.text: The Department of Labor and Employment issues a cease-and-desist order against a union organizing a strike in a private company.
The Department of Agrarian Reform distributes land to tenant farmers in a sugar plantation, with just compensation to the landowner.
The National Labor Relations Commission dismisses a complaint for illegal dismissal due to lack of evidence.
The Congress passes a law increasing the retirement age of private employees from 60 to 65.
